title: version must be a recognized JSON Feed version URI

spec.name: JSON Feed
spec.normative_quote: version (required, string) is the URL of the version of the format the feed uses, technically a required field, but it's not required if you were already using JSON Feed and it doesn't validate: https://jsonfeed.org/version/1.1.
spec.note: Recalled from training-data familiarity with the published JSON Feed 1.1 spec, not re-verified against a live fetch this session (this agent has no WebFetch access). The deferred drift probe (ADR 0011 follow-up (h)) must reconcile this quote against a live re-fetch of spec.url before it is treated as verified.

applicability: A parsed feed.json document whose "version" field is present.
